robot-expressive.note: The shared humanoid rig every city character is built on (OVERSTORY-CITY-R033, per OVERSTORY-DESIGN-R012.4): model by Tomás Laulhé, modifications by Don McCurdy (facial morph targets, material cleanup), CC0 1.0 per the folder's README. Pinned at the exact commit of tag r186 — the same three major the repository runs. Attribution: public/city-assets/SOURCES.md.

marker-cube.note: The placeholder marker cube (construction markers, reserved-plot markers). The rest of this pack's rider characters left the city with the 2026-11-19 shared-rig cast (OVERSTORY-CITY-R033); the cube is the only file kept. The pack's OSM/USGS terrain JSONs (ODbL 1.0) were never copied; the city generates its road network instead. Attribution: public/city-assets/SOURCES.md.

city-kit.note: Original city asset kit: 98 families across eight categories, authored in Blender through the blender-mcp pipeline (scripts/asset-kit/), per specs/arbora-city/asset-pack.md launch catalog and authoring protocol (R048.1/R048.2/R048.4). No external sources: flat palette materials, no textures. Per-family export QA reports and multi-angle review renders are recorded in the delivery PR.

characters.note: Civilian character pack: 12 variants over shared rigged base (OVERSTORY-CITY-R049, T102).

verification: Each entry is verified by the app at startup: one fetch, byte-count and SHA-256 comparison against this file, one retry, then a typed asset.failed event and the placeholder fallback on second failure. The verified bytes are reused by the renderer (verified-byte cache), so a pinned file is fetched exactly once. Paths are site-absolute; assets live under public/city-assets/ and are copied verbatim into the built app.
